title: ahwootech/BRUTAL
why_read: A low-level C# game engine framework giving direct access to native APIs and Vulkan, notable for powering real shipping games like RimWorld's new engine.
analysis: BRUTAL provides thin, low-level bindings to native graphics and system APIs (including Vulkan) from C#, letting developers build custom engines without the overhead of a full game engine like Unity or Unreal. It's notable because it underlies real production projects, including Kitten Space Agency and RimWorld's rewritten engine, lending it credibility beyond a hobby project. This is relevant to engine programmers interested in low-level graphics programming in a managed language.
